name: staggered-dropdown
title: Staggered Dropdown
description: An actions menu that unrolls below a button, with an icon and label on every row.

meta.interaction: Clicking the button flips its chevron and unrolls the panel downward from its top edge; the rows then fade up one after another, each icon popping to full size a beat after its label. Picking a row closes the menu in reverse.
